verdict: Yes. Paleoo Bakes from Mumbai pitched healthy sweets on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Indians love sweets but want less sugar and refined flour, and sugar-free, keto and millet versions of traditional sweets have a growing market.
angle: Diabetics, fitness-focused buyers and parents look for sweets made with jaggery, dates or natural sweeteners. Festivals and gifting drive large orders. Shelf life and taste are the main challenges.
